ns2:section.sectionText: For Fall 2021, Sections AL1, AL2, ALP, and ALR will alternate having half of students meet in classroom space and the other half meeting synchronously online on Tuesdays. Which students meet in classroom space and synchronously online will be swapped on Thursdays. This section does not have a separate lab. This section is NOT for DGS prep or ENG undeclared. Please view the following link for restrictions and release dates: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/csregister
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for BS:Computer Engineering -UIUC or BS:Electrical Engineerng -UIUC.
